title: Check-in and Check-out Procedure
content:
Arrival Information (Check-in):
Check-in time starts from 16:00 (4:00 PM).
Please ensure we know your exact arrival time in advance, which allows us to expedite the handover of your digital door codes or keys smoothly.

Detailed check-in procedure:
• 3 days prior to your arrival date, you will receive an email and an SMS containing a direct link. You must register the identification details of all accompanying guests (ID / Passport) and authorize the security deposit pre-authorization. This is a temporary hold that is automatically released after your departure. Both passport registration and the security deposit are mandatory steps required by Spanish hospitality law.
• In the same email, you will find a personalized link to your private Guest Portal. There you will find comprehensive guides on your property, neighborhood, amenities, pool access, and local recommendations.
• Once the payment is settled, all guests are verified, and the deposit hold is authorized, on the morning of arrival you will receive your digital keyless door code or key collection instructions. The vast majority of our properties feature smart digital keypads for seamless self-check-in.

Departure Information (Check-out):
Check-out is strictly until 11:00 AM to allow our housekeeping team (Just Banús) to prepare the accommodation for the next guests.

title: Air Conditioning & Climate Control Guide
content:
Instructions for optimal climate control:
• Cooling mode is indicated by the snowflake icon (❄). We recommend setting the thermostat to 22°C - 24°C.
• Heating mode is indicated by the sun icon (☼).
• Crucial notice: Always ensure all terrace sliding doors and windows are fully closed when the A/C is active. Most systems have automatic sensors; open doors will cause the compressor to shut down to prevent coil freezing and excessive energy waste.
• If the unit does not switch on, check the main breaker panel in the entryway to verify that the 'Climatización' switch is set to ON.

title: In-Room Electronic Safe Instructions
content:
Most properties include an electronic digital safe inside the master bedroom wardrobe:

1. Keep the safe door open. Press the red reset button on the inside rim of the door.

3. Test locking and unlocking twice while the door remains open before locking away your valuables.
If the safe displays a low battery warning or locks out, contact reception for the physical override master key.

title: Washing Machine: Operating Guide & Troubleshooting
content:
Standard operating guide for the utility room washing machine:
1. Load clothing without overloading the drum. Add liquid or powder detergent into the main compartment (II).
2. For quick washes, select 'Rápido 30 min' or 'Eco 40°C'.
3. Ensure the door clicks firmly shut before pressing Start / Pause (▶||).
4. Safety notice: Once the cycle completes, wait approximately 2 to 3 minutes for the magnetic thermal door safety lock to release automatically before pulling the handle.

title: Dishwasher: Operating Guide & Troubleshooting
content:
Dishwasher operation:
• Insert detergent tablet into the dispenser flap on the inner door.
• Select the 'Eco 50°' or 'Auto' program.
• If the red indicator for salt (S) or rinse aid is illuminated, the machine will still operate normally.
• Should the machine beep or pause, inspect the spray arms to ensure tall dinner plates or cookware are not obstructing rotation.

title: Rubbish Disposal & Recycling Rules
content:
Municipal waste collection rules in Marbella:
• Waste containers are located at designated street collection points throughout the urbanization.
• Green / Grey containers: General household waste (must be deposited in tied bags after 20:00).
• Yellow containers: Plastic containers, cans, and cartons.
• Blue containers: Paper and cardboard.
• Green igloos: Glass bottles and jars.
Please do not leave rubbish bags on terrace floors or outside apartment doorways at any time.

title: Non-Resident Taxation: What is Modelo 210 IRNR & When to File?
content:
Non-resident property owners in Spain are legally required to file Non-Resident Income Tax (Modelo 210 IRNR):
• If rented out: Declarations are submitted quarterly on rental profits. EU/EEA residents may deduct operational expenses (maintenance, community fees, depreciation) and pay 19%; non-EU residents (including UK citizens post-Brexit) pay 24% on gross rental income without expense deductions.
• If exclusively for private vacation use: An annual deemed income tax (imputación de rentas) is payable by December 31st based on the cadastral value (valor catastral).
Iberiansun manages the calculation, preparation, and electronic filing with the Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Tributaria) with full English bilingual documentation.

• Tasa de Basura: Municipal waste collection levy billed twice yearly.
• We set up direct debits (domiciliación bancaria) with Spanish and international IBANs, preventing late payment surcharges, bank embargoes, or utility shutoffs.
